name: zeffect_runtime_node_action_callback
description: zEffect::RuntimeNodeActionCallback advances an active effect runtime entry, applies fade-in or fade-out scale updates, clamps the scale floor, and recycles/removes the node after fade-out completes.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Binary Ninja has x87 flag-lift warnings at 0x4621cd and 0x462217, so functional evidence relies on reviewed assembly plus targeted native behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4621b0 validates inactive-node early return, elapsedSec += g_FrameDeltaTimeSec, fade-in currentScale update and Object3D scale call, fade-out scale subtraction with 0.01 clamp and scale call, callbackContext clear, PushBackPayload to freeList, action callback clear, active clear, optional RemoveChild from runtime parent, and return of RemoveChild or 0.

The native runtime-callback smoke verifies inactive return, fade-in elapsed/scale update, fade-out floor clamp, free-list recycle, callback/action/active clearing, and parent removal. zeffect_init_smoke covers the callback through the spawn/recycle runtime flow.
